name: Fuel for the Zapping
summary: On the Forgotten Coast, Zorbin Fandazzle puts his engineering shop to work in a poor place. The elementals trouble him, but their water cores can power the refining of the Ultra-Shrinker.

sections.title: Power from the Surf
sections.body: Zorbin Fandazzle curses the unchecked power of elementalism and calls the coast's elementals pests. Yet he sees their water elemental cores as raw power for refining the Ultra-Shrinker. He asks you to fight the Sea Elementals and Sea Sprays along the coast. Keep their cores and bring them to him by the dock.

sections.title: Zorbin's Thanks
sections.body: Zorbin is delighted with the cores. They will keep his work going for some time, and fewer elementals now roam the coast. He admits that opening his shop in what may be the worst place imaginable gave him reason to cry at night. The payment strains his finances, but he offers it in gratitude.

faq.q: Who is asking for the elemental cores?
aliases: who gives fuel for the zapping
who starts fuel for the zapping
faq.answer: Zorbin Fandazzle is asking for the elemental cores. His engineering shop is by the dock on the Forgotten Coast of Feralas.

faq.q: Why does Zorbin Fandazzle need water elemental cores?
faq.answer: Zorbin Fandazzle needs water elemental cores as raw power for refining the Ultra-Shrinker. He considers the local elementals an ideal supply.

faq.q: Where are the elemental cores gathered?
faq.answer: Gather the cores from Sea Elementals and Sea Sprays along the Forgotten Coast of Feralas.
